findings.comment:
Repeat Violation

A follow-up is scheduled for 4/6/2026 to ensure the ice machine has been cleaned and sanitized. Inspector recommends hiring a third party such as AirMasters to deep clean and sanitize the machine.

(A) A FOOD specified in 3-501.17(A) or (B) shall be discarded if it: (1) Exceeds the temperature and time combination specified in 3-501.17(A), except time that the product is frozen; (2) Is in a container or PACKAGE that does not bear a date or day; or (3) Is inappropriately marked with a date or day that exceeds a temperature and time combination as specified in 3-501.17(A).

During pauses in FOOD preparation or dispensing, FOOD preparation and dispensing UTENSILS shall be stored:(C) On a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food-contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized at a frequency specified under §§ 4-602.11 and 4-702.11.

findings.title: Food separated and protected.
findings.comment:
Repeat Violation

Inspector observed the following storage order violations in the facility:

1. Limes stored below and on top of raw ground beef
2. Raw beef stored above cooked chili (walk-in cooler)
3. Raw bacon stored above cooked chili (walk-in cooler)
4. Raw shell eggs stored above cut tomatoes (standing 2-door cooler)

Ensure staff are storing raw ingredients below ready-to-eat (RTE) foods to prevent cross-contamination. A follow-up will be conducted on 8/11/2025 to ensure proper storage order is being followed in the facility.
findings.citation_text: 3-302.11(A)(1) Packaged and Unpackaged Food - Separation, Packaging, and Segregation. (A) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by: (1) Except as specified in (1)(d) below or when combined as ingredients, separating raw animal FOODS during storage, preparation, holding, and display from: (a) Raw READY-TO-EAT FOOD including other raw animal FOOD such as FISH for sushi or MOLLUSCAN SHELLFISH, or other raw READY-TOEAT FOOD such as fruits and vegetables, (b) Cooked READY-TO-EAT FOOD, and (c) Fruits and vegetables before they are washed; (d) Frozen, commercially processed and packaged raw animal FOOD may be stored or displayed with or above frozen, commercially processed and packaged, ready-to-eat food.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.comment:
Observed several TCS items in kitchen coolers to not be datemarked.
1) Observed open packages of turkey and ham deli meat in cooler to not be date marked. Items were discarded. 
2) Observed corn and mashed potatoes in a crock pot in cooler to not be date marked. Items were discarded. 
3) Observed container of chili in cooler to not be date marked. Item was discarded.

3-501.17: (A) Except for ROP, Refrigerated, RTE, TCS Food prepared and held in a food establishment for more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked to indicate the date/maximum of 7 days. Day of preparation is Day 1 (Pf). (B) Date marking may not exceed manufacturer’s use-by date (Pf). (C) Combined portions of food shall retain the date marking of the earliest-prepared food (Pf). (D) Approved date marking systems (C). (E)  Does not apply to repacked from a bulk container (C). (F) Does not apply to shellstock (C).  (G) Exemptions: prepared deli salads prepared according to 21 CFR 110; hard cheeses (39% moisture); semi-soft cheeses (50% or less); cultured dairy products (yogurt, sour cream, buttermilk); preserved fish (pickled herring, dried/salted); dry, fermented sausages (pepperoni); and salt-cured products (prosciutto and parma).

(P) (D) Reheating may not exceed 2 hours.(P) (E) Unsliced portions of MEAT roasts may be reheated according to oven parameters and minimum TCS conditions. (C)

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment:
6-501.111: PREMISE shall be maintained free of insects, rodents, and other pests. If present (A) Routinely inspect shipments of FOOD and supplies (B) Inspect PREMISE routinely (C) Using methods, such as trapping devices Pf (D) Eliminate harborage conditions. 

Observed two live adult roaches in the facility. One was in the back bar on the floor next to a milk crate while the other was in the cabinet under the coffee service area where pizza ovens were formerly located. Sentinel came out and did a thorough pesticide application on November 1, 2022. The facility bar and kitchen were closed for 5 days. After cleaning and treatment had time to work, the bar was opened on 11-06-22 with hamburgers offered for Sunday. The kitchen is open again for minimal service. Sentinel will be back out this week to perform another in depth treatment.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-201.16: (A) Wall and ceiling covering materials shall be attached so that they are EASILY CLEANABLE. (B) Except in areas used only for dry storage, concrete, porous blocks, or bricks used for indoor wall construction shall be finished and SEALED to provide a SMOOTH, nonabsorbent, EASILY CLEANABLE surface. 

The wall covering material at the part wall between the service door and the mop sink is in disrepair. It is loosely attached and not easily cleanable. Seal up this area so that it is attached and easily cleanable with no gaps or cracks.
* Continue to seal any area that could provide harborage for insects. 
Also, from the last routine inspection, the area around the serving window counter has gaps and cracks and is not considered smooth or easily cleanable. This area is scheduled to be renovated. Shelves in the pool kitchen have been replaced with new stainless adjustable shelves.

findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.comment:
3-302.11: Cooked chicken was observed to be uncovered on the bottom shelf of the standing cooler in the kitchen. Ensure all food items are properly covered during storage in a manner that does not pose a threat to potential contamination from the above shelves.
3-302.11: (A) (1)-(2) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination during storage, preparation, holding, and display (P). (3) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by cleaning visibly soiled containers, removing damaged containers, separating washed and unwashed produce (C).

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-602.13: Some service tables in the lobby and throughout the facility need to have the left over food residue cleaned off of them. Ensure all surfaces are cleaned and sanitized after use to prevent the accumulation of food debris and to limit the potential food source for pests.
4-602.13: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.16: The mop head was observed to be stored in the basin of the mop bucket. This item was moved during the inspection into the top portion of the mop bucket that will allow the mop to properly air dry.
6-501.16: After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to airdry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies.

findings.title: No bare hand contact with RTE food or a pre-approved alternative procedure properly allowed
findings.citation_text: 3-301.11 (P) Food employees used bare hands to handle ready to eat foods. Observed employee handle french fries and chicken fingers with bare hands. Food was discarded. Observed second employee to use bare hand in bag of potato chips for service to a plate. The chips were discarded before they reached the plate. Food employees shall use suitable utensils such as deli tissue, spatulas/tongs, dispensing equipment or single use gloves when handling ready to eat foods. Reference 3-301.11. Employees were coached on proper food protection.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.citation_text: 6-501.111  (Pf) Roaches observed, live, in the facility on glue boards. Roaches are juvenile. The premises shall be maintained free of insects, rodents and other pests. Eliminate pests utilizing proper pest control processes as needed. Reference 6-501.111. The faiclity has a regular pest control operator. They will be out tomorrow. Faiclity has been being treated for at least two months.

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display
findings.citation_text: 3-307.11  (C) Food is not protected from contamination at kitchen where a soiled fian is blowing into the grill area. Also the lines over food preperation areas have some dust and soil accumulation. Food shall be protected from contamination. Reference 3-307.11. Clean and maintian free of accumulated soil.

findings.title: Wiping cloths: properly used and stored
findings.citation_text: 3-304.14  (C) In-use wiping cloths are not stored properly. Cloths used for wiping spills shall be maintained dry. Cloths used to wipe surfaces and equipment shall be held in proper sanitizer solution. Cloths in-use for wiping surfaces in contact with raw animalfoods shall be kept separate from cloths used for other purposes. In-use cloths must be laundered daily. Reference 3-304.14. Observed wiping cloth on cash drawer in bar and on prep table cutting board. Store wiping cloths properly at all times.

findings.title: Single-use/single-service articles: properly stored and used
findings.citation_text: 4-904.11  (C) Single-service articles are not protected from contamination at the service bar. Observed single use forks to be stored with tines up.  Single-service articles shall be handled, displayed and dispensed so that food and lip contact surfaces are protected from contamination. Reference 4-904.11.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(B) and (C)  (C)  Grease and soil accumulation present on the seals of the prep table and shelves across from the cooking equipment in the kitchen. Thoroughly clean all cooking equipment and pans. Reference 4-601.11(B) and (C).

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices
findings.citation_text:
5-202.11  (P ) Plumbing at the spray handle is not designed , constructed and installed properly. Contact a licensed plumber to repair/replace to comply with Illinois Plumbing Code. Reference 5-202.11. A new faucet was ordered. 
Follow up in 10 days per SCDPH meeting.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment: 6-501.12 (A & B) (C) Floors are observed to be soiled in difficult to reach areas of the facility. Physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Except for cleaning up a spill or other accident, cleaning should be done during periods when the least amount of food is exposed such as after closing.  Reference 6-501.12 (A & B). Clean at the end of day to help in the elimination of pests.
findings.citation_text: 6-201.11  (C) [Floors, Walls and Ceilings] in the kitchen area were found in a state of disrepair, or not to be smooth and easily cleanable. Except as specified in Section 6-201.14 and except for antislip floor coverings or applications that may be used for safety reasons, floors, floor coverings, walls, wall coverings, and ceilings shall be designed, constructed, and installed so they are smooth and easily cleanable.  Reference 6-201.11. Photos were shared with the Elks club for their reference.

findings.title: Allergen training as required
findings.comment:
PA 100-0367, Section 3.07 
Not all of the certified food managers have completed the required online food allergen awareness training. Requirements for allergen training were discussed, and information was provided for management to find an online course. All certified food managers need to complete the food allergen awareness training by the next routine inspection.

findings.title: Consumer advisory provided for raw/undercooked food
findings.citation_text:
3-603.11  (Pf) A consumer advisory is not provided for serving raw or undercooked food. Discussed disclosure and reminder requirements. Consuming raw or undercooked meats, poultry, seafood, shellfish, or eggs may increase your risk of foodborne illness, especially if you have certain medical conditions. Reference 3-603.11.
Facility serves ceaser dressing made with raw egg.

findings.title: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control
findings.citation_text:
3-501.15  (Pf) The method of cooling is inadequate. Use one or more of the following methods based on the type of food being cooled: placing the food in shallow pans; separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; using containers that facilitate heat transfer; adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Discussed HACCP concept with the person in charge. Reference 3-501.15.
Provide date and time log for cooling foods. Smoked wings were cooked today around 9am per the manager. The wings were placed into the walk in to cool at 10:15am. When checked at approximately 11am the wings were 55F.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.citation_text: 4-602.13  (C) Soil residue present on the following non food contact surfaces: 1) serving table with heat bar 2) pizza oven 3) soda gun holder at small bar 4) Ghel's machine and pizza ovens no in use 5) coffee maker. Clean all non-food contact surfaces frequently to prevent soil accumulation.  Reference 4-602.13. Clean and maintain these items free of accumulated soil.
